samples.xml_description:
<module id="div_16bit">
    <description>Divide a 16-bit number by an 8-bit number.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="A" width_description="[15:0]">Dividend.</input>
        <input id="B" width_description="[7:0]">Divider.</input>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">Quotient.</output>
        <output id="odd" width_description="[15:0]">Remainder.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>Two always blocks are used for this module. One is a combinational block triggered by changes in inputs A and B, updating register a_reg with the value of A and register b_reg with the value of B. Another always block is also triggered by changes in inputs A and B, performing the division operation.</implementation>
</module>
